title: Picou compared with Lorenzo Tio as a teacher
summary: Joe says Picou and Lorenzo Tio were both famous, with Tio known as the teacher of Barney Bigard, Albert Nicholas and Omer Simeon.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Let me ask you, Joe, how famous was he compared with someone like Lorenzo Tio?
No, no, no. Lorenzo was... In a way, he was just as famous.
Picou, in New Orleans. But Tio was more or less famous as a teacher.
Lorenzo Tio, Junior, we're talking about.
Yeah. He was a great teacher.

Would you say there's any thread with those clarinet players, coming from... Say I played you a record of a New Orleans band. Is there any way you could tell who taught that guy? Could you tell Tio had taught him...?
